question.zh-CN: 如何把异构设备、模型和技能组成可开发、可调试的机器人系统？
question.en: How are heterogeneous devices, models and skills composed into a developable and debuggable system?

name.zh-CN: 操作系统与通信中间件

problem.zh-CN: 组织进程、消息与分布式组件。
problem.en: Organize processes, messages and distributed components.

research.zh-CN: 实时通信、模块化与系统架构。
research.en: Real-time communication, modularity and system architecture.

industry.zh-CN: 版本支持、部署配置与兼容性。
industry.en: Version support, deployment configuration and compatibility.

compare.zh-CN: 消息时延、服务生命周期与可诊断性。
compare.en: Message latency, service lifecycle and diagnosability.

name.zh-CN: 驱动、硬件抽象与控制接口
name.en: Drivers, hardware abstraction and control interfaces

problem.zh-CN: 统一传感读取与执行器命令。
problem.en: Unify sensor reads and actuator commands.

research.zh-CN: 接口抽象、控制切换与仿真实机一致性。
research.en: Interface abstraction, controller switching and sim-real consistency.

industry.zh-CN: 驱动维护、校准、故障码与设备支持。
industry.en: Driver maintenance, calibration, fault codes and device support.

compare.zh-CN: 接口覆盖、状态语义与时序一致性。
compare.en: Interface coverage, state semantics and timing consistency.

problem.zh-CN: 组合感知、规划与控制模块。
problem.en: Combine perception, planning and control modules.

research.zh-CN: 可插拔算法与端到端系统比较。
research.en: Pluggable algorithms and end-to-end system comparison.

industry.zh-CN: 场景整定、机器人适配与稳定版本。
industry.en: Site tuning, robot adaptation and stable releases.

compare.zh-CN: 集成成本、任务完成率与异常处理。
compare.en: Integration cost, completion and exception handling.

name.zh-CN: 技能库、行为树与工作流
name.en: Skill libraries, behavior trees and workflows

problem.zh-CN: 表达任务顺序、并发与恢复。
problem.en: Express task order, concurrency and recovery.

research.zh-CN: 技能组合、形式约束与层级决策。
research.en: Skill composition, formal constraints and hierarchical decisions.

industry.zh-CN: 可视化编排、接口版本与操作权限。
industry.en: Visual orchestration, interface versions and operator permissions.

compare.zh-CN: 技能复用率、失败定位与恢复路径。
compare.en: Skill reuse, failure localization and recovery paths.

problem.zh-CN: 解释系统运行中的数据与故障。

research.zh-CN: 因果调试、日志压缩与可解释执行。
research.en: Causal debugging, log compression and interpretable execution.

industry.zh-CN: 回放、可视化、报警与远程诊断。
industry.en: Replay, visualization, alerts and remote diagnostics.

compare.zh-CN: 复现故障时间、日志完整性与排障成本。
compare.en: Time to reproduce failures, log completeness and diagnosis cost.

problem.zh-CN: 让机器人与电梯、门禁、机队协同。
problem.en: Coordinate robots with lifts, doors and fleets.

research.zh-CN: 多智能体调度、冲突消解与协作。
research.en: Multi-agent scheduling, conflict resolution and cooperation.

industry.zh-CN: 设施协议、任务系统、交通与权限。
industry.en: Facility protocols, task systems, traffic and permissions.

compare.zh-CN: 拥堵、吞吐、资源等待与异常恢复。
compare.en: Congestion, throughput, resource waits and exception recovery.
